assessment: This article makes two important, independent contributions to the multicellularity/major transitions literature. First, it sheds light on the concept of ‘fitness decoupling’, providing a strong mathematical foundation for the claim that the fitnesses of cells and groups cannot be formally decoupled during an evolutionary transition in individuality. Second, the article proposes using the evolution of tradeoff-breaking traits as an indication that an evolutionary transition has occurred. This dovetails well with existing fitness-based approaches, extending the toolkit of those studying major evolutionary transitions.
